concept: Website and CRM as one sheet. One made-up concertina leaflet standing on a red paper sweep, rendered in 3D (Blender): white card, seven pages, a black numeral and a name on each (Website, Enquiries, Quotes, Bookings, Jobs, Hosting, then the Nexulabs wordmark) and one red line running through every fold. It opens from behind page 1; the frame tracks along pages two to five; the first fold from above, the line going round it unbroken; then on to the end of the sheet. Signal red, card white and black.
